primitives.verbatim_quote: Engine logic reconstructed `out/equations.py`, 21 functions, wired to real payload semantics: - `completion_probability` — logistic; situational basis fitted on 3,820 real NGS rows, tracking covariates (separation, cushion, closing speed) enter as logit shifts.

primitives.name: Ghost Density
primitives.verbatim_quote: - `ghost_density` / `interception_probability` — anisotropic conditional density of a baseline defender, normalised so it integrates to the defender count (measured 5.03 for 5/side).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'ρ(x)': 'density function at position x', 'μ_i': 'mean position of defender i', 'Σ_i': 'covariance matrix of defender i', 'Z': 'normalization constant'}
primitives.assumptions: Defenders modeled as multivariate Gaussians with known means and covariances.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When defender positions are unknown, defaults to uniform distribution.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphs to spatial field theory where defenders form a probabilistic influence map.

primitives.name: HMM Coverage Decode
primitives.verbatim_quote: - `hmm_coverage_decode` / `coverage_responsibility` — non-homogeneous 2-state HMM over reaction-to-motion, emitting MAN_FOLLOW / ZONE_PASS_OFF / ZONE_SPOT_DROP.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'q_t': 'hidden state at time t', 'o_t': 'observation at time t', 'P(q_t | q_{t-1})': 'transition probability', 'P(o_t | q_t)': 'emission probability'}
primitives.assumptions: Two-state Markov chain with time-varying transition/emission probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When motion data is insufficient, uses prior state distributions.

layer2.mapping: Models defensive behavior as a non-homogeneous 2-state HMM over motion reactions.
